notes.title: Controller Support Added, New Pictograms and Widgets
notes.notes: [p]A new Steam update introduces full controller support, along with redesigned pictograms and widgets to improve navigation and the overall user experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660295/3ee4426486c226160ed2d6cebb78cc2ff59643fd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The frozen room opened.
notes.notes: [p]A [b]new room[/b] has opened in [b]Motel Nightmares[/b]! But be careful - in here you’ll freeze within minutes, so you’ll need to move fast! The frozen rooms echo with howling winds, falling snow, and nothing to keep you warm... or is there? How long can you endure the cold? But wait - what if spiders attack you in the meantime?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660295/b4b789691bb86acae4d39586501be47bfbf17320.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: We’ve reached 1,000 wishlists on Steam!
notes.notes: [p][b]We’ve reached 1,000 wishlists on Steam![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]The Motel Nightmares community is growing steadily, and it’s all thanks to you. We’re incredibly grateful that you believe in us and help bring us one step closer to our dream. This is just the beginning – we’ll be back soon with more exciting news![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t already, add [b]Motel Nightmares[/b] to [b]your Steam Wishlist or share this[/b] news — it helps us a lot![/p]

notes.title: DEMO is regularly updated! - 12+ updates and counting!
notes.notes:
[p]The [b]Motel Nightmares[/b] demo is alive and evolving! Since launch, we’ve released [b]12+ updates[/b], and we’re not slowing down. Each update brings improvements, bug fixes, performance tweaks, and sometimes even new content - all based on your feedback and our ongoing development.[/p][p]🔹 Found a bug? Let us know!
🔹 Have feedback? We’re listening.
🔹 Want to stay up to date? Check the News tab for full patch notes.[/p][p]We’re committed to making this the best experience possible.
[b]Follow the game[/b], [b]wishlist the full version[/b], and keep the nightmare alive.
Thanks for being part of the journey! 💀🏨[/p]

notes.title: DEMO Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660295/a5c91b10e0763d07e0a928e27af1bca10bca80eb.png"][/img][/p][p]We're excited to announce that the [b]Motel Nightmares DEMO[/b] is now available on Steam![/p][p]Step into the haunting world of our upcoming horror game and experience a glimpse of what awaits behind the motel doors. Explore, survive, and uncover the secrets lurking in the shadows.[/p][p]🔪 What’s included in the demo:[/p][list][*][p]A section of the motel to explore[/p][/*][*][p]Atmospheric horror and creepy surprises[/p][/*][*][p]A taste of the full game's story and mechanics[/p][/*][/list][p]We'd love to hear your thoughts — your feedback helps us improve and shape the final game.[/p][p]👉 Try it now and let us know what you think!
🖤 Enjoyed the demo? Don’t forget to [b]add [i]Motel Nightmares[/i] to your wishlist[/b] to stay updated and support the development![/p]

notes.title: DEMO COMING SOON!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660295/0558742fd86b517b5a1fd4346bc6e3c0c1dfefbf.png"][/img][/p][p]We're excited to announce that the [b]demo version of [i]Motel Nightmares[/i][/b] is coming [b]very soon[/b] — expected to launch in [b]mid-July[/b]![/p][p]The upcoming demo will give you a first taste of the eerie motel atmosphere, including:[/p][list][*][p]A playable section of the game with exploration, tension[/p][/*][*][p]A sneak peek into the story and mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Support for multiple languages, including Hungarian and English[/p][/*][*][p]Atmospheric sound design and visual effects[/p][/*][/list][p]Stay tuned, wishlist the game, and don't forget to follow us for the latest updates![/p][p]Thank you for your support — we can’t wait for you to check in to the motel…[/p]
